title: Martial arts programs that train people to sense being looked at

tellings.quote: because in the martial arts there are various martial arts programs where they train people to know when they're being looked at from behind

plain: Some martial arts programmes are said to train people to know when someone behind them is looking at them. The researcher Rupert Sheldrake tells Michels this without naming a particular school or source. He offers it as a sign that the feeling of being stared at may be a real sense that can be trained.
